stage: Discovery amendment after inspecting the original 12 target problem statements and base code
reason: Same-repository oldest-source/latest-target pairing mostly yielded different mechanisms. Preserve those controls; search remaining problem statements against the already frozen source cards instead of writing target-specific memories.
candidate_pool: All other distinct issue IDs in row group zero for the 12 selected repositories, excluding all 24 source candidates and the 12 original targets. A candidate must have a PR created_at later than the selected memory source's PR created_at.
input: Pinned SWE-rebench task columns from intake-plan.json only; no additional trajectories, target solutions or outcome columns
retention_rule: Record the complete candidate pool. Promote for code review only when the visible problem description exposes the specific condition or a close competing contract of one frozen memory. Do not require predicted benefit, and do not manufacture a matching condition.
review_order: Repository order in intake-plan.json, then ascending created_at and instance_id
budget: At most 52 additional issue statements, at most six promoted current targets for detailed base-code review. No worker/model calls, training or GPU allocation.
